verdict.rationale: Teams docs show first-party natural-language interaction via Copilot Chat and chat-based agents (e.g., 'Create an agent and chat with it in Teams', 'Copilot Chat in Outlook and Teams', 'Securely interact with Copilot using web data and work data'), plus agent slash commands for structured NL-style commands within chat. However, this covers a Copilot/agent layer rather than full natural-language control of core Teams operations (calls, meetings, admin), and there's no independent/hands-on evidence corroborating how broadly NL commands actually replace manual UI actions. Missing for 10: independent verification of NL command coverage across core Teams features, and evidence of NL control beyond the Copilot/agent chat surface.
